summary: Frontend-only sweep of Neocad's model-mode ribbon. Loaded app at http://localhost:5173/?token=… — welcome dialog dismissed, sidecar pill shows 'ready'. Created a Box primitive programmatically, then invoked every action from ribbonDefs (all groups + every chevron split-button leaf) via window.__neocad.handleAction and captured (status pill, #prompt banner, active-tool map, choice/dialog presence, page errors). Verified the far-plane / grid regression by wheel-zooming out ~16 notches and reading the 'Grid N mm' HUD (5→20→50→200→500→2000 mm, no black viewport, grid drawn across full viewport at Grid 2000 mm — confirmed FIXED via screenshot). The annotation-scale regression could not be automation-driven because sketch begin/rectangle-add is not exposed on window.__neocad.sketch; no page errors from any sketch-related invocation. Zero page errors during the entire sweep.

ui_bugs.issue: handleAction('revolve') requires a pre-selected sketch profile and only emits the status 'Revolve: select a sketch profile to revolve first' — it does NOT enter an interactive profile-pick / axis-pick state. Same UX for Extrude ('needs a face or a closed sketch profile') and Sweep ('select a profile sketch region first'). The user asked for a revolve flow where you can select a face and drag to adjust angle/screw and create threads; the current flow is dead-ends until the user manually clicks a sketch region in the browser tree.

ui_bugs.component: Boolean tools (union / subtract / intersect) with only 1 body
ui_bugs.issue: Invoking union/subtract/intersect while only one body exists is completely silent — no toast, no status pill text, no prompt. Compare with Interference which correctly says 'needs at least two bodies'. Users will click Union with one body and get no feedback.

In a plain browser (not the Tauri shell) all three print actions early-return on `if (!isTauri()) return;` without any user feedback. Silent no-op is confusing — even Tauri-only features should tell the user 'Requires the desktop app' or hide/disable in the ribbon.

Silently appends a scale-feature with factor=1 (a visual no-op) to the timeline and leaves the user to edit it via value rows. There is no prompt/status confirming a feature was added; a user pressing Scale would think it did nothing. Compare Clean Up which does emit 'Clean Up added, bodies unified from here on'.

gracefully_guarded_when_precondition_mis: extrude — 'Extrude needs a face or a closed sketch profile'
revolve — 'Revolve: select a sketch profile to revolve first'
sweep — 'Sweep: select a profile sketch region first'
interference — 'Interference: needs at least two bodies'
silent_or_confusing: union / subtract / intersect with a single body (no message at all)
print-export / print-orca / print-send (early-return in browser without a message)

zoomed_out_grid_far_plane.evidence: Grid readout stepped 5 → 20 → 50 → 200 → 500 → 2000 mm across 16 wheel-out notches; at Grid 2000 mm the ground grid is still drawn across the whole viewport (screenshot /app/test_reports/02_zoomed_out.png), no hard cut-off line, viewport not black.

sketch_annotation_scale.note: window.__neocad.sketch does not expose begin()/addRectangle() so I could not scripted-draw a rectangle then zoom out. No page errors were raised during any sketch-related invocation. Main-agent hand-verified this fix; keeping as-is.

action_items: Give Revolve/Sweep/Extrude an interactive profile-pick step (or route them through the same 'pick a sketch region' overlay Loft uses) so the user can start them with nothing selected — this is the biggest unfinished UX gap the sweep found and directly blocks the user's 'revolve end-to-end' goal.
Guard union/subtract/intersect with a 'Boolean needs at least two bodies' status (mirror of Interference).
Either disable print-export / print-orca / print-send in the browser build or surface a 'Printing requires the desktop app' toast; today they are silent no-ops.
Consider a small confirmation status for Scale so users know a scale feature was added to the timeline.
critical_code_review_comments: featureStarters.ts is 1071 lines — over the 700-line guideline; splitting per-family (create/modify/analyse/print) would make the 'silent boolean' and 'silent scale' asymmetries easier to spot.
print/printFlow.ts guards with `if (!isTauri()) return;` without user feedback — same anti-pattern in openInOrca / sendToPrinter; consider a shared `requireTauri('Printing')` helper that toasts.
actions.ts dispatch is a 250-line switch — booleans are already extracted; consider a `STARTERS: Record<string, () => void>` map for the ~30 no-arg starter cases.

success_rate.frontend: Ribbon sweep 42/42 actions invoked without page errors; ~25 tools start correctly, 4 are gracefully guarded, 6 are silent/confusing (see list). Regression #1 PASS, regression #2 not directly verifiable via automation.

test_credentials: no auth — token in URL only
seed_data_creation: Created a 40x40x40 mm Box primitive at origin via store.addFeature for tool-precondition tests. No persistence; discarded on reload.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sidecar auth token rotates on restart — always re-read /tmp/sidecar.log line 1 after any restart. window.__neocad exposes store/viewport/sketch/overlay/handleAction/busyWhy — use handleAction(name) to invoke ribbon actions headlessly and busyWhy() to see which tool is active. Status pill text is on `button[title*="click for the full text"]`; the viewport instruction banner is `#prompt`. sketch begin/addRectangle are NOT on the dev handle — to drive the sketch stack from an e2e you'll have to synthesize pointer events on the canvas after action('sketch') + clicking a plane.
